messages:
maya: CI red on hosted-integ shard-7 — several failures that touch auth + streaming + toolcall. failing job: hosted-integ-shard-7 #2481. can someone rerun the shard and grab the raw proxy logs? :wave:

jorge: @maya on it. i'll kick a rerun but paste a failing log snippet if you have one so i can grep traces quickly.

maya: here's the core from the runner logs (redacted):
```
2026-05-03T14:13:02.341Z ERROR auth-proxy request failed status=401 path=/v1/stream trace=7f2a9c auth_err=invalid_credentials missing_headers=[forwarded-client]
2026-05-03T14:13:02.342Z DEBUG body="{\"msg\":\"toolcall init\"}"
```

oncall-bot: Rerun requested: hosted-integ-shard-7 #2481 — rerun started by jorge at 1729456860.

liam: seeing similar locally when token rotation happens during long-lived stream setup. auth-proxy strips/rewrites some headers on rotation. could be the new header-preservation change. @olivia did we ship anything touching header passthrough yesterday?

olivia: i deployed a tiny change to auth-proxy yesterday to normalize TTL header and i accidentally touched the header propagation logic (PR #1924). rolling back that piece now. repro steps: start proxy with AUTH_PRESERVE_HEADERS=true and hit /v1/stream with an expiring token.

maya: rerun finished — still 401s but traces show "missing_headers=[forwarded-client]" consistently. test names: tests/integration/hosted/test_stream_toolcall.py::TestToolCall::test_auth_retry and tests/integration/hosted/test_auth_proxy.py::TestProxy::test_header_forwarding.

jorge: ok. plan: 1) attempt a bisect between hosted-integ@v1.12.3 and main to locate commit that touched header propagation; 2) if bisect is slow, try CI env override AUTH_PRESERVE_HEADERS=true or set AUTH_PROXY_STRIP_HEADERS=false for the shard to see if tests become green. who can run the bisect?

liam: i can run a lightweight bisect locally against the auth image diff. if we need a full git bisect in CI i can script it but will take ~30-45m. i'll start local image compare now.

olivia: i'm spinning a canary with the previous auth image (v1.12.2) and will run the two failing tests against it. ping me in ~10m for results.

maya: thanks all. tagging this thread as blocking release-candidate until we confirm rollback/bisect. quick note: adding a temporary skip for TestProxy::test_header_forwarding would reduce noise but i'd prefer to avoid masking regressions unless we have a clear rollback. :eyes:

jorge: started a targeted rerun with env override for shard-7: `CI_ENV=auth_override ./scripts/ci/rerun_shard.sh shard-7 2481` — will post outcome.

oncall-bot: Rerun completed at 1729457099 — job still failed (401). attached build logs at https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2481/logs.

liam: local bisect found candidate commit 3f9d7a1 that modified header rewrite rules. pushing a patch to revert that small change and run the integration matrix. i'll open PR and link here.

olivia: can confirm canary with v1.12.2 auth image passes the two failing tests locally. this narrows it to the header-change.

maya: good signal. @security please review the header-revert PR for regressions before merge. I'll hold RC until we have a signed revert or alternate fix.

jorge: thanks team — keeping this thread updated. small TODOs: liam open revert PR, olivia validate canary in staging, maya flag release. i'll coordinate the cherry-pick if PR looks good. :thumbsup:
